item: Reader marks a cited link to a kept paper with its class and notices (row 214)
summary: The reader's Sources this article cites list now marks each link to a PubMed, PMC or DOI record this install keeps with the Papers subtab's badges: class (Journal record, Preprint, Retracted) with the same hover, notices (Erratum published, Expression of concern, Retraction notice) and Withdrawn from PubMed. Local only: each link is looked up on its own through papers_cited_by over medical.db; a lane never fetched is not opened and no file is created; a link whose paper is not kept here gets no mark (R750); labels about the cited paper, never a verdict on the article. Server-side in view_article, no new route or store; existing keys, translated by the reader's i18n pass (Chromium-checked en and ar). Release line: An article's link to a paper this app holds now shows that paper's status, such as retracted or preprint, in the reader.
